# CreditFix Kit

DIY credit repair kit — $47 one-time. https://creditfixkit.mehyar.us/

## What it is
A personalized PDF kit: the 5 FICO score factors translated to the buyer's
situation, 3 mail-ready letter templates (bureau dispute under FCRA Sec. 611,
collector validation under FDCPA Sec. 809, goodwill adjustment for late
payments), and a 12-month month-by-month rebuild plan adapted to the buyer's
situation (collections / late-payments / thin-file / mixed).

## Honesty rules (site-wide)
- General information only — not legal or financial advice.
- No guaranteed score increases, no promised removals. Results vary.

## Free teaser
POST /api/creditfix/teaser {situation, goal?} → score-factor explainer +
locked letter previews. No auth, no email required.

## Paid flow
1. Buyer completes intake on the site → POST https://mehyar.us/api/pay/checkout
   {product_id:"creditfix-kit", email, params:{name,situation,state,goal,accounts},
   success_url, cancel_url} → Stripe.
2. Webhook creates creditfixkit_orders (status paid, access_token) and triggers
   POST /api/creditfix/generate {order_token}.
3. Buyer downloads the PDF at /api/creditfix/pdf?token= or
   deliverable.html?token=.
